title: [Decision] Two more framework writers land organization-less rows under a wall before C8 stage 8b: flow credentials (`sys_flow_credential`) and boot-seeded declared webhooks (`sys_webhook`)
body:
Ruled: 6259141885 · letters Q1 A · Q2 A · 2026-10-19T03:40Z

Filing gate **②**: a decision only the maintainer can make. The maintainer asked for this card in the epic seat's chat: 「用决策卡。24378 也重开，带上你的新意见和我们的讨论」. Reader who acts: the maintainer rules; the epic PM (`epic:#15194`, `session_01Y5583bs2RDd53MH6kM1ca3`) executes.

**Dedupe.** Semantic search on objectstack-ai/objectstack:
- "sys_flow_credential organization column deployment-level env-wide flow credential tenant": 4 hits, none asking this;
- "bootstrapDeclaredWebhooks seeder declared webhooks registry retire sys_webhook rows boot": 5 hits, all closed, none asking this.

Blocks: C8 stage **8b** (#15212). After 8b, the engine refuses an organization-less system insert under a wall, so both writers would start failing there.

**Source.** A read-only writer census the epic seat ran on `origin/main` `e22defb13`, before dispatching 8b. It was run so that #24377's late discovery does not repeat.
- It covered the 44 in-reach platform objects, less the 9 admitted ones and the 5 #24377 already ruled, leaving **30 candidates**.
- 2 candidates need a decision. 1 needs only a stamp. The rest always derive an organization, or have no framework writer.

## 维护者速读

**一句话问题：** 8b 落地后，隔离部署下凡是"写入时推不出组织"的系统写入都会被拒。普查又找到两处这样的写入：**流程凭据**、**启动时自动复制的软件包 webhook**。每处要定一个去向。

| | 今天 | 选项 A(席位推荐) | 选项 B | 选项 C |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| **Q1 流程凭据** `sys_flow_credential` | 保存/发布带签名密钥的流程时写,不带组织。对象注释自称「整个环境一份」(`sys-flow-credential.object.ts:33`,`unique: 'global'` `:117`),表却带组织列,仪式又按组织数据处理(`organization-ownership-inventory.ts:599`)—— 三处矛盾 | **改为部署级**(去组织列,`systemFields: { tenant: false }`),归属跟流程走(流程本是环境元数据,D2/D6);与 #24377 Q4「`sys_secret` 归属跟引用行走」一致;D7 加一行;随 8b-0de 做 | 保留组织列,隔离下拒绝带密钥的流程保存 —— 隔离部署无法用签名 webhook/http 流程 | 保留组织列,按发布者会话的组织盖章 —— 流程是全环境的,凭据却分组织,另一个组织运行同一流程时找不到凭据 |
| **Q2 声明的 webhook** `sys_webhook` | 每次启动把包里声明的 webhook 复制成无组织的行(`bootstrap-declared-webhooks.ts:256`,`webhook-outbox-plugin.ts:322`)。D2 原文「No seeder writes them into any table」,但退役清单漏了它;8c-0 后这些行在隔离下已让认证挡住 | **退役种子程序**,声明的 webhook 从注册表读取(与 stage 9 对共享规则的做法相同);仪式删除镜像行(D10 fate 2) | 定为部署级:声明 webhook 进无组织列的同构表,保留种子程序 —— 与 D2「声明不落表」相悖 | 不处理:8b 后隔离部署下声明的 webhook 静默消失(拒写被 `:258-276` 捕获只记 warning) |

**你要做的：** 各回一个字母，例如「Q1 A Q2 A」。

**工作量与位置：**
- **Q1 A** 约 0.3–0.6k 行，并进 8b-0de(同批改仪式清单与 D7)。
- **Q2 A** 约 0.8–1.5k 行，作新阶段 **8b-0g**：排在 8b-0de 之后、8b 之前(都改仪式文件，只能串行)。关键路径约 +0.5–1 天。
- **D7 那一行:** 若在您合并 PR #24422 之前裁决，就并进 #24422，省一次 Tier H 审批。#24422 正因 #24378 重开而暂缓。

**无需决定、照做：** `sys_share_link` 在用户生成分享链接时写入，不带组织(`share-link-service.ts:665`)。但组织推得出来(记录和会话都在手上)，在 8b 前补上盖章即可，是一个小阶段。

## Measured (all at `origin/main` `e22defb13`)

- **The exemption today.** `resolveSystemInsertOrganization` (`packages/objectql/src/engine.ts:7165`) runs on every insert. Any in-reach `sys_`/`cloud_`/`ai_` object that is not on the 9-entry admit list (`platform-object-tenancy.ts:124-229`) returns at `:7183`, before the posture is read, so it lands NULL in every posture. 8b retires that exit.
- **Q1.**
  - The writer is `service-automation/src/flow-credential-channel.ts:341`, under `{isSystem:true}` (`:85`).
  - It is called from the metadata save door (`metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts:23987`) and from the one-time migration (`flow-credential-migration.ts:222`).
  - No organization is threaded.
  - The inventory row reads `fate: 'attribution'`, "under single the Default Organization; otherwise reported" (`:599`).
- **Q2.**
  - The writer is `plugin-webhooks/src/bootstrap-declared-webhooks.ts:256` under `SYSTEM_CTX` (`:109`). It runs on every boot (`webhook-outbox-plugin.ts:322`).
  - The inventory keeps the rows with a label only (`:529`, "not named by D10 fate 2, so they stay").
  - Their `sys_http_delivery` tail follows the webhook's organization (`auto-enqueuer.ts:887`, `:1228-1235`).
- **Lean compositions change no answer under a wall.** A walled posture is refused before the organization object is checked (`core/src/security/system-write-organization.ts:115-117`).
- **Latent, no decision.** None of these has a live caller or path, so 8b's refusal is acceptable for each:
  - `sys_scim_connection_credential`: its mint has no caller and is not exported.
  - `sys_setting`'s user rung for a walled user with no active organization: no built-in user-scope key exists.
  - `sys_import_job` by an operator with no organization: a narrow case.

## Recommendation: **Q1 A · Q2 A**

- **① Long-term soundness.**
  - Q1 A makes the object say one thing in three places. A flow is environment metadata, so its credential is too.
  - Q2 A completes D2's own sentence. Stage 9 already did the same for sharing rules, so the pattern exists.
- **② Business need.** Both writers are live: signed webhook and http flows, and declared webhooks in packages. Under a wall, 8b would break them, and Q2's failure would be silent.
- **③ AI error-proofing.**
  - Q1 A removes a tenant column that no writer can fill.
  - Q2 A removes a boot-time mirror whose rows block certification.
  - Q2 C would turn a refusal into a warning-only disappearance.
- **④ Startup focus.** Q1 A is the smaller change. Q2 A reuses stage 9's shape. Neither adds a capability.

os-decision-facets
- ① 项目长远合理性:Q1 A 让对象三处说法一致(流程是环境元数据,凭据随之);Q2 A 补全 D2「声明不落表」,复用 stage 9 的形状。
- ② 实际业务拉动:两处都是活写入(签名 webhook/http 流程、包内声明的 webhook);隔离部署下 8b 会让它们失效,Q2 还是静默失效。
- ③ 防 AI 犯错:Q1 A 去掉一个无人能填的租户列;Q2 A 去掉启动时的镜像;Q2 C 把拒写变成只记 warning 的消失。
- ④ 创业阶段不扩散:Q1 A 改动更小;Q2 A 复用既有形状;都不新增能力。

自检：只看①选 Q1 A、Q2 A；②③④ 是否翻转：否。

**Confidence gap.** Whether cloud's control plane relies on declared webhooks under a wall is unknown. This session cannot read the cloud repo.

Related: #15212 (the C8 plan), #24377 (the first four walled fates), #24422 (the D7 PR, held), #23952 (stage 9, the registry pattern).
